scale_contract: 2x2 placement footprint, ground0, +Z up/-Y front. Dimensions, rail angle and socket are authored, not recovered metric calibration.
interpretation: Own sixteen direction heads establish one flattened inclined tapered blade with two elongated grooves over a narrow rotating cradle. Prior two round muzzles are superseded by own source anatomy.

Two front hooked brass fittings and long stripe/smaller red side flag govern fixed anatomy. Exact hidden structure,bearing,groove depths and sections are authored;generic PB18/ST18 and turret optimiser ST31 are context only. No firing,recoil or autonomous scan timing inferred.
